contributors.acute_haemodynamic: sympathetic_per_pressure_deficit (1.0, PROVISIONAL) x (1 - pressure_rel), arrival-relative (the baroreflex stimulus; already separate from D).
contributors.arrival_rest: S_rest: the arrival drive the arrival debt does not explain (the arrival pressure deficit and anything unmodelled), constant; only the arrival-relative stimuli move the drive below it.
contributors.caps_floors: floor: drive >= 0 (sinus HR >= intrinsic). No upper cap or saturation in the core (the family engine clamps its display to [42, 180]: LEGACY_REFERENCE only).
contributors.case_specific: none: the GI module writes no HR or drive; no GI-specific decrement.
contributors.debt: debt_to_sympathetic_gain x D (P2I-2AE; was sympathetic_per_debt x (D - D0) / tau_D).
contributors.direct_deficit: none: no term reads the instantaneous effective oxygen deficit or delivery.
contributors.drugs_interventions: none acts on HR directly: fluids, red cells, haemostasis and oxygen act through V, Hb, the bleed flow and SpO2; beta_blockade is a constant case parameter (0: none authored).
contributors.intrinsic_rate: R.rate_bpm = intrinsic_sinus_rate (case parameter; undeclared: the arrival HR, no sympathetic share). The sinus floor: the drive is never negative.
contributors.other_stimuli: hypoxaemia (0.02 per SpO2 point below 94) and hypoglycaemia (0.01 per mg/dL below 70), arrival-relative.
contributors.rhythm: authoritative: a non-sinus perfusing rhythm keeps its own rate; no pulse, no pulse rate; scripted rhythm events and the collapse rule (off) change R.
contributors.sympathetic: aux.sympathetic_drive x hr_per_sympathetic_drive (25 bpm per unit, ADOPTED) x (1 - beta_blockade).

deficit.acute_term_present: the pressure deficit (1 - pressure_rel), arrival-relative: an acute haemodynamic stimulus, separate from D before and after this package
deficit.why: the faculty expectation (acute response to current shock, persistent drive with debt memory) is met structurally by the existing acute pressure term plus gain x D; an anaemia or hypoxaemic under-delivery at preserved pressure reaches the drive only through D (and SpO2 through hypoxaemia). Whether an oxygen-delivery term should be added is a faculty question, not a semantic error, so none is invented.

audit.new_equation: sinus: HR = R.rate_bpm + 25 x (1 - beta_blockade) x drive (unchanged); drive dynamics unchanged. target = max(0, S_rest + 1.0 x (1 - pressure_rel) + debt_to_sympathetic_gain x D + 0.02 x delta hypoxaemia + 0.01 x delta hypoglycaemia), S_rest = S0 - debt_to_sympathetic_gain x D0 >= 0 (else the arrival is inconsistent and the core stops). At arrival the target is S0, so the arrival HR is reproduced exactly; tau_D appears nowhere.
audit.old_equation: sinus: HR = R.rate_bpm + hr_per_sympathetic_drive (25) x (1 - beta_blockade) x drive; non-sinus: HR = R.rate_bpm; no pulse: no pulse rate, drive 0. drive: rises at once to the target, decays toward it with exp(-1 / 5 min). target = max(0, S0 + 1.0 x (1 - pressure_rel) + 0.5 x (D - D0) / tau_D + 0.02 x delta hypoxaemia(SpO2 < 94) + 0.01 x delta hypoglycaemia(glucose < 70)), S0 = (HR_arrival - intrinsic) / (25 x (1 - beta)), intrinsic = the declared rate or the arrival HR, pressure_rel = output x tone relative to arrival.

tau_d_paths.why: at fixed D and lactate, tau_D rescaled the debt term. Before P2I-2AC, D settled at deficit x tau_D, so D / tau_D read as a lagged deficit; since P2I-2AC D does not repay under a deficit and the division only rescaled the debt's drive by the repayment time.

tau_d_paths.why: tau_D sets how fast D repays; the drive reads D itself.

gain.old_reason: sympathetic_per_debt (0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0) was a drive per unit of D / tau_D: one point meant a different gain at each tau_D, so the range carries tau_D in its units and cannot be translated into an independent gain. The gains it induced are reported for comparison only.

d_scale.support: (g, gain, D0) -> (c g, gain / c, c D0) leaves HR unchanged

debt_to_sympathetic_gain.support: [0.0006667, 0.128] less the analytic rejections; only gain x D0 at arrival and gain x g over a run reach HR

intrinsic_sinus_rate.support: the band (60 / 80 / 100, capped at the arrival HR) less the analytic rejections

saturation_or_cap.support: the core has no HR cap or saturation

sympathetic_per_pressure_deficit.support: 1.0 (PROVISIONAL), not varied: it sets how far restored pressure unloads the arrival rest

intrinsic_vs_gain.why: every consistent (intrinsic, gain) pair reproduces the arrival HR exactly; above the floor the intrinsic rate cancels (the HR gaps between intrinsic levels at the same gain are rounding only); no post-arrival HR is authored to separate the gain

identifiability.rule: Available HR observations: the authored arrival HR of each case only. Exact structure: while the drive is positive, HR(t) = HR_arrival + 25 x [gain x (D(t) - D0) + pressure, hypoxaemia and glucose deviations] with the decay lag, so the intrinsic rate cancels and reaches HR only where the floor binds; the arrival HR fixes intrinsic + 25 x (S_rest + gain x D0) and S_rest is free and non-negative, so it constrains only the sum intrinsic + 25 x gain x D0 <= HR_arrival.

intrinsic.why: gi_reference.RESTING_HR is the resting adult sinus range (60 / 80 / 100), capped at the authored arrival HR; its rule reads no HR1 probe, no D, no tau_D and no gain. Under the current physiology it keeps one role: the sinus floor R.rate_bpm the drive falls back to (the arrival share is the authored HR less it). P2I-2AE adds only a joint constraint, intrinsic + 25 x gain x D0 <= arrival HR (non-negative S_rest), applied as an analytic rejection, never by moving the band.

statements.1: increasing D with all else fixed never lowers HR
statements.2: a larger acute critical deficit never lowers the sympathetic drive
statements.3: restoring adequate oxygen delivery permits sympathetic recovery
statements.4: HR recovery may lag because D persists
statements.5: haemostasis alone does not force immediate HR normalization
statements.6: one PRBC unit does not force a fixed HR decrement
statements.7: the second unit's effect may differ by state
statements.8: the crystalloid HR response depends on the resulting physiology, not on the fluid's identity
statements.9: the intrinsic rate is the floor of the sinus rate
statements.10: zero output / no pulse stays consistent with the rhythm and pulse semantics

legacy_reference.rule: LEGACY REFERENCE, NOT A CALIBRATION TARGET: the family engine's HR at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min, read after the verdict, never by the gain range, a flag, an invariant, identifiability or the verdict.

policy: Shadow only. The P2I-2AD representatives (its committed record) and synthetic probes on the GI arrivals, never the P2F historical region. tau_D repays D only; the debt-driven drive is debt_to_sympathetic_gain x D, explored on a range built before any HR outcome; the arrival HR is intrinsic + a non-negative sympathetic contribution, inconsistent arrivals rejected analytically. HR post-processed exactly (validated, else stop). No HR envelope is invented; no SBP, MAP or RR is calibrated; the legacy HR is read after the verdict only; nothing is fitted, selected or approved; collapse stays off.

scan_rule: The (intrinsic level, gain) plane, 3 x 6 (five range points and the 0 reference), post-processed on each of the 18 representative runs (3 tags x 2 cases x L1 / L2 / L3): no simulation beyond the 18 runs and the validation reruns. Analytically rejected pairs are never read. The intrinsic slice is read at the gain anchor (the range's log-midpoint) and the gain slice at intrinsic midpoint; neither is a selection.

validation.rule: HR does not reach output, delivery, D, lactate or RR (live_audit; the drive is read only by derive's sinus rate). Each representative (tag, case, scenario) is simulated once by the full core at the default gain and intrinsic midpoint; for any other (intrinsic, gain) the drive is recomputed minute by minute from that run's pressure_rel, SpO2, glucose, D and rhythm with the core's own arithmetic (target, rise at once, decay with tau 5). Validated on full core reruns (gain at both range ends and 0, intrinsic lower / upper at the scan anchor): drive, HR, RR, D and lactate equal exactly, else the run stops.

Pressure and vascular tone follow HR; not started.
verdict.rule: HR_STRUCTURE_READY_FOR_NUMERIC_FACULTY_CALIBRATION when every check holds: (1) tau_D no longer reaches HR (the core's source and the fixed-D probe at every tau_D level); (2) the contributors are explicit (the audit, and every reported minute's contributions add up to its HR within 1e-9); (3) the arrival decomposition is coherent (every consistent pair reproduces the arrival HR exactly, the analytic rejections are exactly the pairs the core refuses, and each case keeps a consistent pair with a positive gain at every arrival-debt level); (4) the ten directional invariants pass; (5) no structural patient-like flag in any read run; (6) the support is explicit (gain range and identifiability table); (7) nothing is approved (no value selected; the default profile unchanged); and the post-processing agrees with the full core. Otherwise HR_STRUCTURE_NOT_READY with the first blocker. No numeric HR band is required.
